501.title: Invoice export: background export job and download API
501.body:
## Problem

Customers with hundreds of invoices cannot get them out of the portal.

## Scope

Add an `export_jobs` table, `POST /api/exports` to start an export, and `GET /api/exports/:id` to poll it and download the file.

## Verification

- A migration test creates and drops `export_jobs`.
- An API test starts an export and downloads the finished file.

502.title: Invoice export: Export button and progress on the invoices page
502.body:
## Problem

There is no way to start an export from the portal.

## Scope

Depends on #501. Add an Export button to the invoice list that starts an export through the API and shows its progress.

## Verification

- A component test shows the button starting an export.
- A screenshot shows progress and the download link.

503.title: Invoice export: email the download link when an export finishes
503.body:
## Problem

Large exports take minutes, and customers leave the page.

## Scope

Depends on #501. When an export job finishes, email the download link to the person who started it.

## Verification

- A test shows one email queued when a job finishes.
- No email is sent for a failed job.

510.title: Pagination drops the last invoice on the final page
510.body:
## Problem

`pageBounds` returns an inclusive end, so the last row of the final page is cut off.

## Scope

Return an exclusive end from `pageBounds` in `app/lib/pagination.ts`.

## Verification

- A unit test shows page 2 of 15 invoices ending at 15.

511.title: Settings page: the save button reads 'Svae'
511.body:
## Problem

The submit button on the settings page is misspelled.

## Scope

Fix the button label in `app/views/settings.tsx`.

## Verification

- The settings page test reads the label Save.

512.title: Invoice footer says 'recieve'
512.body:
## Problem

The invoice email footer misspells receive.

## Scope

Fix the footer text in `app/views/footer.tsx`.

## Verification

- The footer reads receive.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- The canonical tracker is GitHub issues in acme/ledger-app, configured in `.agents/managing-issues.json`.
- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.
